user.title: Smart Heating
user.description: Set up room-by-room smart heating. Add rooms afterwards via Configure.

heating_settings.title: Boiler and presence settings
heating_settings.description: EasyControl climate entity (the boiler call), people who count as home, the low (no demand) and high (demand) EasyControl setpoints, Boost and Manual-room override durations, and the bedroom pre-bed warm-up window (used by the bedroom preset when a room is saved).

data.arrival_entities: Heading-home signal (optional; e.g. a 'near home' zone (active while someone is in it), or a switch that is on. Ends Away/Vacation early so the house warms before you arrive)

report_settings.title: Gas report settings
report_settings.description: Weekly report on Mondays. Compares m3 per heating-degree-day with the same week last year (needs recorder long-term statistics for both entities).

add_room.title: Add a room
add_room.description:
{reason}

Schedule: one comfort window per line, e.g. `mon,wed,fri 08:00-17:00`, `mon-fri 07:00-09:00` or `daily 06:00-23:00`. Outside the windows the room is at setback.

data.name: Room name
data.manual: Manual room: radiator valve turned by hand, no Zigbee (not for floor heating or open radiators)
data.floor_heating: Floor heating (no TRV; needs a sensor; starts very early)
data.open_radiators: Open radiators (no TRV yet; needs a sensor; stops the boiler once warm)
data.trv_entity: TRV (not needed for manual, floor heating or open radiators)
data.sensor_entity: External temperature sensor (required for floor heating and open radiators)
data.presence_entities: Who is this room for? (optional; no scheduled heating while all of them are away)
data.arrival_entities: Heading-home signal (optional; e.g. a 'near home' zone (active while someone is in it), or a switch that is on. Warms the room early)
data.preset: Schedule preset (used when the schedule below is empty)
data.trv_offset: TRV sensor offset (0 = let the system learn it)
data.window_drop: Open-window drop (maximum; learned lower per room)

advanced_settings.title: Boiler call and alert thresholds
advanced_settings.description: Debounce and backoff of EasyControl writes (Bosch cloud rate limit), demand hysteresis, and alert thresholds.

data.backoff_base_minutes: First backoff after a failed write
data.demand_hysteresis: Demand hysteresis (room must be this far below target)
data.trv_settle_minutes: Radiator valve: wait this long after a write before checking it
data.easycontrol_settle_minutes: EasyControl: wait this long after a write before treating a difference as a manual change
data.easycontrol_manual_hold_minutes: EasyControl: respect a manual change for
